title: Panda Adventure boot configuration
description: Authoritative boot config for the walking skeleton (gADR-0000: JSON is the single source of truth). Converted to data/generated/boot_config.tres (a GameConfig Resource) by scripts/build_config.py.

block_color.description: Block color as RGBA, each component in 0..1.

block_size.description: Block size (width, height) in pixels; each strictly positive.

start_position.description: Block start position (x, y), in pixels.

target_position.description: Block tween target position (x, y), in pixels.

tween_duration.description: Tween duration in seconds; strictly positive.
